paragraphs: Yitzḥak, or R. Yitzḥak. R. Abba bar Yitzḥak; Adda bar Yitzḥak; R. Aḥa bar Yitzḥak; Rav Ḥanan or Ḥinena bar Yitzḥak; R. Tuvyah or Tuvyah bar Yitzḥak; R. Yishmael bar Yitzḥak; Levi bar Yitzḥak; Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak; Rabbah bar Yitzḥak; R. Shila bar Yitzḥak; Rav Shemuel bar Yitzḥak. [Glosses: Yitzḥak. (a) In Ḥullin (77, end of side a): R. Yitzḥak bar Nappaḥa; 'bar' is a scribal error, not corrected. (b) In Niddah (65, end of side b): R. Yitzḥak son of R. Yose said: R. Yoḥanan said. In my opinion it should read Yosef; not corrected. (c) In Bava Kamma (52a–b) and Yoma (77b): R. Yitzḥak bar bar Ḥana. In my opinion it should read R. Yitzḥak, the son of Rabbah bar bar Ḥana. (d) Ketubbot (4, beginning of side b): R. Yitzḥak bar Ḥanina said in the name of Rav Huna; in that account at 61a: bar Ḥananyah. (e) Bava Batra (163a): Rav Yitzḥak ben Elazar; in most places, Rabbi [rather than Rav]; not corrected.]
